name: vix_mean_reversion_intraday_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: India VIX itself mean-reverts within the trading day. When VIX drops > 3% from its opening value by mid-morning, it tends to recover partially, and vice versa. This intraday VIX pattern creates a tradeable signal for Nifty50 stocks: when VIX drops sharply (complacency), go short high-beta stocks anticipating VIX bounce and stock weakness. When VIX spikes sharply intraday, go long anticipating VIX fadedown. The edge exists because VIX is primarily traded via options, and the intraday VIX dynamics are a byproduct of options market maker hedging, creating predictable mean-reversion windows.

indicators.name: stock_beta
indicators.formula: rolling 20-day beta of stock to Nifty50

conditions: vix_change_from_open > 3 (VIX has spiked > 3% intraday — fear spike)
vix > vix_ema_30 (VIX above its intraday average — room to mean revert down)
long.confirmation: VIX starts declining (vix < vix[3] — 3-bar VIX downtick)

short.confirmation: VIX starts rising (vix > vix[3] — 3-bar VIX uptick)

risk.position_sizing: vol_adjusted — inversely proportional to current VIX

filters.vix_filter: core to strategy — only trade when VIX moves > 3% from its open
filters.time_filter: no entries before 10:00 (let VIX stabilize) or after 14:30
filters.volume_filter: target stocks must have normal volume
filters.trend_filter: counter-trend by design — VIX spike = long; VIX drop = short
filters.event_filter: skip on budget day, RBI policy, expiry day

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — VIX intraday dynamics are driven by options market structure, slow to change

weaknesses: VIX spikes > 3% intraday are infrequent — maybe 5-8 times per month; low trade frequency
In genuine crisis (geopolitical, COVID), VIX spike is one-way and doesn't revert same day
High-beta stocks during VIX spikes have wider spreads, increasing slippage to 4+ bps
prior_art: VIX intraday mean reversion — documented in US market (CBOE VIX). India VIX adaptation.
notes: This is a selective strategy — only fires on volatile days. Good complement to calmer strategies.
